title: Planet with rings
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='planetGrad' cx='38%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb3d9'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#e05aa0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8e2a63'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='ringGrad' x1='0%' y1='0%' x2='100%' y2='0%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7fe3ff'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#c9f7ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#5ac3e6'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- back half of ring -->
  <path d='M6 52 Q50 22 94 46' fill='none' stroke='url(#ringGrad)' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- planet body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='26' fill='url(#planetGrad)'/>
  <!-- surface streaks -->
  <path d='M28 40 Q50 32 72 42' fill='none' stroke='#ffd0e8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M26 56 Q50 50 74 58' fill='none' stroke='#b8407c' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M31 68 Q50 62 69 69' fill='none' stroke='#ffd0e8' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- front half of ring -->
  <path d='M6 52 Q50 82 94 46' fill='none' stroke='url(#ringGrad)' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M10 52 Q50 78 90 47' fill='none' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
